name: Nemesis Lockdown

categories.label: All public Solo/Coop Objectives fulfilled
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành tất cả mục tiêu công khai
categories.hint: One public Solo/Coop Objective card per player; ALL must be fulfilled.

categories.label: Characters alive after the Victory Check
categories.labelVi: Số nhân vật còn sống sau Victory Check
categories.hint: At least 1 Character must survive; the one fulfilling an objective must be alive.

categories.label: Team wins
categories.hint: All objectives fulfilled and at least 1 Character survives.

winCondition: Fully cooperative mode: draw one public Solo/Coop Objective card per player. The team wins if ALL these Objectives are fulfilled and at least 1 Character survives the Victory Check (a Character tied to an Objective must be alive after it). Solo mode: fulfil your Objective and survive.

endCondition.description: Game ends when the Time token reaches the red purge slot or the Autodestruction/Alert slot and advances further, the Facility explodes (13th Fire or 11th Malfunction marker), or the last living Character in the Facility leaves or dies; then the Victory Check is resolved.

notes: family: coop. No points. Verified against the official rulebook (Solo & Cooperative Mode section). Solo mode uses the same win test with 2 Solo/Coop Objective cards (choose one after the first Encounter); not a separate file.
